---
name: Feedback or criticism
about: Tell us where the framework is wrong, unclear, or unworkable
title: ""
labels: feedback
---

**Which part?**
(A section, principle, test, or "the whole idea." Which edition?)

**What situation did you apply it to?**
(Your work, a conversation, an AI system you use, a hypothetical. Leave out details that could identify other people.)

**What went wrong, or what's missing?**
(A wrong answer, a vague one, an assumption that doesn't hold where you are, something it doesn't account for.)

**Anything else?**
(Small observations are welcome. Many of the framework's best parts started as small ones.)

**How would you like to be credited if this leads to a change?**
(A name or handle, or "anonymous.")
